* **Claude Web**: 
  * Available at [https://claude.ai/](https://claude.ai/). 
  * General purpose.
* **Claude Desktop**: 
  * Software application running on your computer where you can schedule tasks and have the agent read and modify your files.
  * General purpose.
* **Claude VS Code Extension**: 
  * Extensions in VS Code that gives the coding agent access to read and modify your files.
  * Optimized for coding.
